SELECT 
  ma.clustsize AS cluster_size, 
  AVG(sdp.behavior_scores->>'botlikscore')::NUMERIC AS avg_bot_behavior_index, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.accindex) AS total_account_count 
FROM 
  moderationaction AS ma 
  JOIN securitydetection AS sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey 
  JOIN account AS a ON sd.sectechref = a.accindex 
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      sectechref, 
      jsonb_array_elements(detection_score_profile) AS sdp
    FROM 
      securitydetection
  ) AS subq ON a.accindex = subq.sectechref 
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sdp.behavior_scores) 
GROUP BY 
  ma.clustsize 
ORDER BY 
  cluster_size DESC;

    FROM 
      securitydetection 
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection_score_profile) AS sdp
  ) AS subq ON a.accindex = subq.sectechref 
GROUP BY 
  ma.clustsize 
ORDER BY 
  cluster_size DESC;

SELECT 
  ma.clustsize AS cluster_size, 
  AVG(sdp.behavior_scores->>'botlikscore')::NUMERIC AS avg_bot_behavior_index, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.accindex) AS total_account_count 
FROM 
  moderationaction AS ma 
  JOIN securitydetection AS sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey 
  JOIN account AS a ON sd.sectechref = a.accindex 
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      sectechref, 
      sdp.value
    FROM 
      securitydetection 
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection_score_profile) AS sdp
  ) AS subq ON a.accindex = subq.sectechref 
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(subq.sdp.value) AS behavior_scores(key, botlikscore) 
GROUP BY 
  ma.clustsize 
ORDER BY 
  cluster_size DESC;
